text: A brand new supercar that lasts twenty seconds. A gas station that should not have been touched. And Jinx Z, watching a helicopter fight he can't believe. These are today's best GTA 6 streamer moments, and number one is the most expensive mistake I've seen in this game.
Number seven. Hasan is standing on top of a skyscraper with a backpack. He thinks it's a parachute.
Rule one of Vice City. Check your backpack before you jump.
Number six. Coh Carnage is leading a street race at night. Final lap. What could possibly go wrong?
Cars don't go that fast, Coh. Apparently, in GTA 6, they do.
Number five. The Burnt Peanut has four stars and the cops right behind him. His plan? Steal a private jet.
Four stars, one jet, zero problems. Peanut is built different.
Number four. Agent Zero Zero just pulled into a gas station. He hears something. Is that gunfire?
Lesson learned. Don't hang around a gas station during a shootout.
Number three. Jinx Z is watching Nick Eh Thirty's game on his stream. Nick is on a rooftop, and there's a helicopter coming in.
Jinx Z could not stop laughing. Nick made it look easy.
Number two. Jinx Z is just cruising downtown. Nice and calm. Keep an eye on the right side of the road.
He's calling it the greatest brake of all time. Honestly? He might be right.
And number one. Agent Zero Zero just bought and fully customized a brand new S F ninety. This is the very first drive.
That's today's GTA 6 moments. Which one was the best? Tell me in the comments, subscribe, and come back tomorrow. There's a new one every day.
